_comment: Findings a scan of tools/target-insecure.yaml must produce. The CI detection job resolves each logical_id to a physical resource with `aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources` and checks that a finding with rule_id exists whose resource_arn contains resource_match. 'account_level' findings depend on account state rather than the stack; 'not_covered' rules cannot be triggered by CloudFormation and are tested only with moto unit tests.

from_stack.note: AdministratorAccess is Action * on Resource *; drop this entry if Track A decides IAM-004 only inspects users and customer policies.

account_level.condition: Always fires on the default VPC's default security group in the target region (default SGs ship with rules).
Fires while the account has no password policy or a weak one.
Fires only if the account has no multi-region trail. The Day-1 checklist creates one, so expect this NOT to fire in the team account.
Fires if any trail has log file validation off. The Day-1 trail must have validation ON, so expect this NOT to fire.

not_covered.reason: AWS encrypts every new bucket with SSE-S3 since Jan 2023; default encryption cannot be removed. Covered by moto test only.
Root access keys must never be created. Covered by moto test only.
Needs a key older than 90 days. Covered by moto test only.
Needs credentials unused for 90+ days. Covered by moto test only.
CloudFormation cannot create or share snapshots; making one public in a real account is unsafe. Covered by moto test only.
